title: Finite nonempty affine refinement of a pro-etale covering
statement:
Let S be a nonempty quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. For every pro-etale covering indexed by any type I with members U_i in the small site [sk-def-pe-site], there are n>0, a map alpha:Fin n→I and affine opens V_j of U_alpha(j) such that their composites to S are a pro-etale covering. No separation hypothesis or quasi-compactness assumption on the original covering members is imposed.

Precise quantified statement, in the contexts recorded by the Lean module:
theorem finite_affine_proetale_refinement (S : Scheme.{t}) [Nonempty S] [CompactSpace S]
    (I : Type i) (U : I → S.ProEt)
    (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows (fun k ↦ (U k).left) (fun k ↦ (U k).hom) ∈
      proetalePrecoverage.coverings S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (α : Fin n → I) (V : ∀ j, (U (α j)).left.Opens),
      (∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j)) ∧
      Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ (V j).toScheme)
        (fun j ↦ (V j).ι ≫ (U (α j)).hom) ∈ proetalePrecoverage.coverings S

proof.text: Choose the finite subcover of the affine open cover of S. Pull the given cover back to each affine member. Mathlib QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom supplies a finite affine cover refining this pullback, with open-immersion refinement maps. Since the base chart is an open of S, its pullback to each original member is an open too.

Each finite affine cover of an affine scheme is quasi-compact. Regard it as a pro-etale cover and bind with the base affine cover. Stability under composition gives a pro-etale cover. Replace each affine source by the open image of its open immersion into the original member, using invariance of covering presieves under isomorphism.
The sum of the finite index sets is finite. Joint surjectivity over nonempty S makes it nonempty. Reindex it by Fin n, with n its positive cardinality.
